title: query --at: tiers held at TIME from git history
description: Implements Mark's decision (b) on vouch-faq3.10 (closed). git vouch query --at TIME derives the tier, automation status and endorsed emails a handle held at TIME from the registry's git history (the tier-record and person-file versions committed at or before TIME, the same history check_registry walks), not from the current files. query only; export unchanged. Fixes: promotion after TIME counted backwards; a handle that was automation until T1 read as human at T0<T1 (bridge would authorize a bot-era signature); demotion. tier_at docstring currently says it is not the tier held at when; fix that. DESIGN.md TRQP bridge / query: one line that query and export can differ for past times.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-written tests in tests/test_query.py: promoted after TIME -> old tier at TIME; automation until T1 -> automation=true at T0; demoted after TIME -> old tier at TIME; time before the handle existed -> unknown. tests/trqp: bot-era signature by since-promoted handle -> authorized=false. 3.12 and 3.9 pass, ruff clean.
